kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مُسْتَوْفٍ • (mustawfin) (informal مُسْتَوْفِي (mustawfī), feminine مُسْتَوْفِيَة (mustawfiya), masculine plural مُسْتَوْفُون (mustawfūn), feminine plural مُسْتَوْفِيَات (mustawfiyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the active participle of اِسْتَوْفَى (istawfā, “to fulfill (requirements, etc)”).
